lines.text: David son of Jesse, anointed by the God of Jacob, speaks his last words as the sweet psalmist of Israel.
David says the prophet Nathan spoke through him, and his word was on his tongue.
God says a ruler who rules justly in the fear of God is like morning light at dawn.
David says God made an everlasting covenant with him, ordered and secured in every part.
The worthless are like thorns, and whoever touches them must be armed with bronze or a spear's shaft.
